title: Marketplace Operations Assistant
why_it_fits: Virtual Assistant match. 2 skills: tiktok, admin. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
Remote | 20 hrs/week, hourly | Eastern Time hours required

The Fidget Game is looking for a part-time Operations Assistant to support our marketplace operations and project execution. This role reports to our COO, and the one trait we're looking for above all else is dependability - you take a project, figure it out, and bring it back done, without needing to be chased or hand-held.

What you'll be doing (roughly 50/50 split):
- Marketplace execution- Shopify listing updates and content uploads, TikTok Shop and B2B portal upkeep, daily inventory monitoring (pre-order toggling, partial-stock handling), a weekly report set, and blog uploads. (Note:Amazon listings are owned by our Amazon agency - this role flags issues but doesn't edit.)
- Project execution & coordination- running and coordinating operational projects in Monday.com, including UPC/ASIN/FNSKU data harmonization, COGS backfill work, portal support tasks, and tracking/follow-ups across our ops portfolio.

Reporting structure:
- You'll report to the COO, who owns priorities and evaluation, while executing day-to-day marketplace tasks under our Marketplace & Systems Coordinator. As trust is built, you'll progressively take on more of the listings work.

Schedule:
- 20 hrs/week, distributed across the week - daily monitoring needs a short touch each business day (~1-1.5 hrs), with the remaining ~10-12 hrs/week for project work. Must be available during Eastern Time hours.

Our hiring process:
- One-way video interview paid trial task final interview with our COO 90-day evaluation period.

What you need:
- Hands-on experience with Shopify admin
- Familiarity with marketplace/e-commerce platforms (Seller Central, Walmart, etc.)
- Monday.com experience(required)
- Project coordination experience
- Strong spreadsheet skills

COMPENSATION
- Competitive compensation based on experience and availability.

_____________________________________________________________________

Please note: due to the volume of applications we expect, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
